rounding.per_file: Weighted integer vectors are summed as Decimal, then quantized to Decimal('0.1').
rounding.overall: Arithmetic mean of per-file rubric-rounded totals; final display also half-up to one decimal.
rounding.unrounded_vector_mean: Reported separately; never substituted for mean of rounded file totals.

rubric.brand_weights: Five equal dimensions, each 0.20, separate from quality.

capture_conditions.source: Blind review-inputs-v1.json; capture/runtime not independently executed.

checks: All 40 artifacts physically read; PNG signature, IHDR dimensions, SHA-256 and byte length match artifacts-v1.json.
Current artifact membership exactly equals all 36 inventory-v1.json rows; every inventory field matches its artifact row.
Four brand-reference file/SHA pairs exactly equal brand-only artifact membership.
Nine canonical surfaces × two devices × two themes complete; no missing or duplicate matrix entries.
All five pinned authority file hashes match authority.json.
All 40 originals opened individually using view_image detail=original before scoring array freeze; no thumbnails/contact sheets.
No excluded baseline/provenance bodies, history, peer files, exports, source, or previous score files read.

duplicate_audit.method: Verified exhaustive membership, unique pairs, dimensions, fractions, SHA equality and threshold boolean logic of recorded metrics; pixel metrics not recomputed.

limitations: Recorded duplicate pixel measurements were not recomputed; their exhaustive pair membership, dimensions, fraction arithmetic, hash flags and threshold decisions were checked.

brand-references.json retains a stale 'KyDrive quality scores' phrase in purpose text; artifact roles and review-inputs explicitly identify these as unscored KyDNS brand references. File/SHA membership is correct.
No browser, build, tests, installations, source mutations, commits, pushes, PR changes, external reviews or hand-off services used.

findings.finding: Mobile Discovered header consumes roughly 330px, leaving a large blank gap between the brand and navigation.
findings.bounded_fix: Use the same compact two-row phone shell on the empty Discovered page as the populated pages; prevent empty-page height from stretching the header.

findings.finding: Mobile Settings fieldsets extend to the outer panel edge with right borders cut; three data tables expose only their leading columns without a visible scroll cue.
findings.bounded_fix: Constrain existing fieldset/table wrappers to their phone container; preserve complete field gutters and make horizontal scrolling of existing columns visibly discoverable. Compact Services row padding.

findings.finding: Blacklists spends substantial row height on small mono prose and fragmented URL text; desktop Services repeats orange Save primaries.
findings.bounded_fix: Use ordinary body type for descriptions, retain mono for identifiers/URLs, give source text sensible wrapping, and quiet repeated row Save actions and descriptive orange badges.

findings.finding: Settings nests panel, fieldset and input borders; light login adds a large shadow absent from the otherwise quiet surface language.
findings.bounded_fix: Remove redundant outer framing and the login shadow while keeping named groups and control borders.
